observed_manual_result.symptom: single client visibly stalls while dropping/transferring a carried inventory item

details: Seven Days cursor carry was domain-backed even in network replica mode
partial carry could create a new local item UUID in the replica domain
M7ItemGraphReplicaAdapter only maps IDs originating from the canonical server graph
the new local split UUID therefore passed through to item.drop/item.transfer unchanged
the authoritative server correctly rejected that unknown ID as ITEM_NOT_FOUND
local cursor mutation and subsequent graph synchronization also execute on the client main thread

behavior: network replica Seven Days carry is presentation-only and does not mutate/split the local replica domain
the carry session retains the original server-backed replica item ID
drop and transfer use that original ID through InventoryCommandFacade and M7NetworkItemCommandBridge
network cancel clears only virtual cursor state
offline/legacy Seven Days domain-backed cursor behavior remains unchanged

remaining_performance_watch.risk: predicted item commands can still convert and apply a full projected ItemGraph on the client main thread
remaining_performance_watch.decision: do not change this second layer without a post-rev3 measurement; if a stall remains with ITEM_NOT_FOUND gone, optimize eager projected graph application separately

required_manual_gate: run exact rev3 candidate on Windows double Godot with persistence disabled
one client is sufficient for the first focused gate
pick up a stack with RMB/half-carry in Seven Days profile
drop one item, then drop the remaining carried amount
repeat transfer from carried stack to another inventory/hotbar slot
require no ITEM_NOT_FOUND for the carried source item
require PREDICTION_HEALTH lead to remain bounded instead of jumping to tens of ticks
require no visible client freeze during item action
then repeat with two clients and run repository regression gates before merge
